Carbon majority by mass per EDS, Table 2 (p. 5): C 62.13 wt% (ACNC10-900) and 85.92 wt% (ACNC40-900). BET area 579.4 m2/g is for ACNC40-900 (TriStar II, N2 at 77 K); BET range not stated. No retraction notice; no statement that the H2 data were published before. For extraction: the paper's mmol/g and wt% values are mutually inconsistent (e.g. 15.018 mmol/g corresponds to about 3.03 wt% W1, not 5.14 wt%; 4.6 mmol/g to about 0.93 wt%, not 1.99 wt%), a unit-consistency failure under protocol section 3, not an eligibility issue.
